name: Olist rebuild: Silver to dashboards
description: MGTA 457 Olist project. Runs sql/03_silver.sql to sql/07_dashboard_views.sql in order, then refreshes the three published dashboards. 06_checks.sql ends with a gate that fails when any pipeline check is not PASS, so the dashboard views and the refresh never run on a build that failed a check. Run by hand: the data is a fixed extract, so there is no schedule. Deployed by tools/deploy_job.py.

tasks.description: 03_silver.sql: types and cleans the raw tables, sets rows aside in the quarantine.
04_gold.sql: the star schema, the busy months, routes and states, and the declared keys.
05_metric_view.sql: delivery_metrics, every rate a dashboard filter recalculates.
06_checks.sql: the 24 pipeline checks, the rule counts and the design-document numbers; fails unless every check is PASS.
07_dashboard_views.sql: the small views the dashboards read besides the metric view.
